newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi casinos set June record, eye top year.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi casinos set June record, eye top year.

text.p: Mississippi casinos took in $169 million in June, the highest total for that month since the state began legalized gambling in 1992, the state Tax Commission said.
The June total for the state's 29 casinos was about $3 million below May's total but $16 million above that for June 1996.
So far in 1997, Mississippi casinos have grossed $987 million and are on track to top last year's total of $1.86 billion.

Paul Harvey, executive director of the state Gaming Commission, predicted July would also be a strong month for casinos despite a weekend slowdown when Hurricane Danny hit last weekend. One casino closed voluntarily and several others operated with pared-down staffs.
July is traditionally the busiest month for Mississippi casinos.
